sentences.text: THE HONOURABLE
DR JUSTICE
VENKATA JYOTHIRMAI PRATAPA  WRIT PETITION NO: 1748 of 2024 ORDER:

This Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India with the following prayer:
"...to issue a writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of a writ of mandamus declaring the action of the respondents 4 and 5 in interfering with petitioner and her husband's life and liberty besides civil disputes and coercing me to execute Mortgage Deed dt. 19-08-2023 under the guise of arrest in false FIR as highly illegal, arbitrary and violative of Art. 14, 19, 21 and 300A of the Constitution of India and consequently direct the respondent Nos.2 and 3 to cause an enquiry into the illegal acts of the respondents 4 and 5 towards petitioner and her husband and Thakkaseela Aruna Kumari vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121407671/
2 forcible execution of the Mortgage Deed dt. 19-08-2023 and take appropriate action against the respondents 4 and 5 besides directing the respondents 4 and 5 not to interfere with their life and liberty...."

sentences.text: 2. Heard Ms.V.Sesha Kumari, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri V.Farook, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home.

3. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home, on written instructions, would submit that basing on the complaint of one Chandra Srinivasa Reddy, a case was registered in Cr.No.398 of 2023 under Sections 420, 406 & 409 r/w 34 of IPC of Kurnool Taluka Urban P.S., against the petitioner and her husband.
He would further submit that after due investigation, charge sheet was filed in this matter vide C.C.No.2551 of 2023.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home,
would further submit that both parties were effected compromise in Lok-Adalt Court, Kurnool on 09.09.2023.
He would further submit that the police never interfered in the civil disputes between the parties.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that recording the same, the petition may be disposed of.
5. Recording the above said submissions, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.

Dr. JUSTICE VENKATA JYOTHIRMAI PRATAPA Date: 05.12.2025.
